fields.label: Consumer Accept List
fields.help: A list of consumer projects that are allowed to subscribe to the multicast IP addresses within the range defined by this MulticastGroupRange.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional text description of the multicast group range.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Multicast Domain
fields.help: The resource name of the multicast domain in which to create this multicast group range.

fields.label: Multicast Group Range ID
fields.help: A unique name for the multicast group range.

fields.label: Require Explicit Accept
fields.help: Whether an empty consumer_accept_list will deny all consumer projects.

fields.label: Reserved Internal Range
fields.help: The resource name of the internal range reserved for this multicast group range.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Whether to enable logging or not.
